visual_observations: Rectangular medical-image tiles sit in a dense black-backed grid; white gutters separate examples.
A large semitransparent anatomical body overlays the center, relating examples loosely to anatomy without arrows.
Magenta contours and colored filled masks coexist; caption assigns magenta to expert annotation and overlays to model predictions.
CT/MR, ultrasound, X-ray, pathology, fundus, skin and endoscopy appearances are visible; no legend maps each overlay hue to performance or evidence strength.
The body overlay occludes central image detail; attractive overview but unsuitable for per-case accuracy inspection.

relations.meaning: Expert target outline registered to the shown image; not an optimization arrow.
Shown model mask is aligned to the input example.
Loose anatomical orientation; visual adjacency is not a measured causal or computational relationship.
